{{Quote|A local businessman is doing a deal with some people he's never done business with before and he doesn't trust them. He's asked us to send someone to meet him in the Lucky Despot and make sure the transaction goes smooth.|[[Peawp R'dawc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RBA" />}}
'''Otwi Opawl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] businessman who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Opawl hired the services of the [[R'dawc Bodyguard Agency]] to protect him during a transaction in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. A spacer working for [[Peawp R'dawc]] was therefore tasked to meet the Bith businessman in the [[Lucky Despot]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and protect him at all costs. The spacer escorted Otwi Opawl and effectively defended him during a subsequent attack.<ref name="SWG:RBA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otwi Opawl was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Otwi Opawl was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was involved in the quests given by Peawp R'dawc to beginner players who had chosen a "[[W:c:swg:Brawler|brawler]]" career.<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> The "brawler" profession was later removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005" /> Peawp R'dawc's questline was widely revamped and Otwi Opawl was removed from these quests.<ref name="SWG:HHE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Hoodlums, Hoodlums Everywhere|Tatooine}}</ref>
